experiment.method: single-variable controlled run of md_cg.test_mr_m3 on the clean verification face
experiment.conclusion: the earlier "clean face shows 1 red (test_mr_m3)" was an artifact of requester-side serve env injecting the brain-root variable; on an env without it the face is fully green, which reconciles with verifier baseline results

defect_registered: md_cg test_mr_m3 E23 assertion is not hermetic: it depends on ambient brain-root env instead of clearing it itself
protocol_requirement_proposed: every verdict must declare the env keys in effect (at least the brain-root variable presence) alongside the criteria fingerprint
requester must not measure baselines through a serve whose env differs from the verification face env
env parity becomes part of A3-adjacent evidence: same criteria hash AND comparable env declaration
main_side_action: registered the env-leak defect card; corrected its own earlier evidence record; no source change during this open round
